Module com.example.miniproyecto_sudoku
Package com.example.miniproyecto_sudoku.model.generator

Class SudokuBoardGenerator

java.lang.Object
com.example.miniproyecto_sudoku.model.generator.SudokuBoardGenerator
All Implemented Interfaces:
ISudokuBoardGenerator
public class SudokuBoardGenerator extends Object implements ISudokuBoardGenerator
Class responsible for generating valid Sudoku boards. Creates solved Sudoku grids and assigns fixed cells to initialize playable game boards.
